newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - June 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - June 17.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on June 17. Reuters has not verified these stories and does notvouch for their accuracy.

Indonesian President Suharto has said pressure from developed countries on issues such as human rights, the environment and democracy is getting stronger. He said Indonesia should prove that human rights is implemented in accordance to the country's norms.
Australia and Indonesia have agreed to seek a mutual recognition agreement on standards and to remove non-trade barriers to trading.
PT Posnesia, a newly established Indonesia-South Korea joint venture, may seek some form of tariff protection from the government. PT Posnesia is Indonesia's first stainless steel company.

Manpower Minister Abdul Latief has submitted a new bill to the House of Representatives, which is likely to replace the old labour law. The new bill is aimed at regulating all aspects of manpower management, including training, allocation, protection, termination of working contracts and the right to have a workers' organisation.
